rules.description: Absence of skin lesions, neuralgia, and peripheral nerve thickening
All results of Fite-stain acid-fast-bacilli microscopy tests whose test-name value set is specific to skin or unspecified tissue

params.name: Acid Fast Bacilli (Tests by Microscopic Observation in Skin or Unspecified Tissue by Fite Stain)

gaps.valueSet: Rule 2 generic Fite/acid-fast-stain tests constrained to skin or unspecified-tissue specimen
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, the source HL7 specimen value sets are unavailable, and the unspecified-tissue-specific acid-fast-stain test-name value set has no codes; HADI-R2 retains the coded test-name branches that themselves identify skin or unspecified tissue

gaps.valueSet: Rule 3 organism-specific Noncaseating Granuloma microscopy test
gaps.reason: the source value set has no codes, so the positive-result and abnormal-interpretation branch is omitted; HADI-R3 retains the coded general-test branches paired with the noncaseating-granuloma result value set

gaps.valueSet: Rules 4 and 9: M. leprae or M. lepromatosis nucleic-acid testing in skin or nerve
gaps.reason: every coded source branch requires skin or nerve specimen evidence, which SEM_V1 does not preserve, while all specimen-specific test-name alternatives have no codes; both the positive and all-results rules are omitted rather than dropping the specimen requirement

gaps.valueSet: Rule 6 characteristic skin findings plus exclusion of more common conditions
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the entire rule inoperable because the clinical findings have no codes and RCKMS cannot evaluate absence of other diagnoses, so the rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rule 7 absence of skin lesions, unexplained neuropathy, negative inflammatory markers, and an epidemiologic exposure
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the rule inoperable; the neuropathy and inflammatory-marker value sets have no codes and SEM_V1 has no epidemiologic-link evidence, so the rule is omitted rather than allowing absence of skin lesions alone to report
